## Functions

### default

The default export, declared as `boxen`.

`import boxen from 'boxen'` is the incumbent's surface. A named export here would break
every migration this file exists to serve, so the house rule yields to the host.

```ts
function boxen(text: string, options?: BoxenOptions): string;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `text` | `string` |
| `options` (optional) | `BoxenOptions` |

**Returns** `string`
